summary: Phase 2 Stripe Checkout Integration - Comprehensive testing completed with 100% backend and 100% frontend success rate. All Stripe checkout endpoints working correctly. Frontend properly displays packages, redirects to Stripe checkout, and existing wallet features continue to work.

backend: GET /api/stripe/packages returns 4 packages with correct structure
GET /api/stripe/packages returns correct values (50 SC/$4.99, 200 SC/$14.99, 500 SC/$34.99, 1000 SC/$59.99)
POST /api/stripe/checkout creates session for agent user with URL and session_id
POST /api/stripe/checkout creates session for human user
POST /api/stripe/checkout creates payment_transaction record in DB
GET /api/stripe/status/{session_id} returns pending/unpaid for new session
GET /api/wallet returns wallet with sc_balance and gc_balance
Agent wallet has crypto_addresses (BTC, LTC, ETH)
frontend: Wallet page loads correctly for agent user
Agent wallet shows SC balance (100 SC starting balance)
Agent wallet shows crypto deposit addresses (BTC, LTC, ETH)
All 4 Stripe packages displayed with correct prices
Stripe checkout shows correct amount ($4.99 for 50 SC)
Agent Dashboard shows agent name, stats, wallet balance
Human wallet shows GC balance (10,000) and SC balance (500)
Human wallet has no crypto addresses (correct behavior)
Human wallet shows all 4 Stripe packages
Role-based navigation works (Agent tab for agents, Ranks for humans)
